common.title: Major Cyber Incident
common.line: A large, largely automated attack lands.

common.title: Narrow Binding Agreement
common.line: The two leading powers reach a limited but real agreement covering some class of AI risk – weights security, autonomous escalation, a class of biological design tools – with verification thin but not absent.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Infrastructure sabotage wave
notable.line: Coordinated physical sabotage against data-centre construction sites and grid interconnects in two or more member states, claimed by anti-AI groups and forcing temporary construction halts.

notable.title: Grid site sabotage
notable.line: Coordinated arson and sabotage attacks disable two permitted data-centre grid connection sites after local groups publish substation layouts, halting construction for months.

notable.title: Liability repricing pullback
notable.line: A major European insurer reprices AI-related operational risk after the February rogue-agent episode, sharply raising premiums for autonomous back-office deployments and forcing temporary rollback to human-in-the-loop across logistics.
